Base https://api.printify.com/v1/, endpoint POST shops/{shop_id}/orders.json; headers Authorization: Bearer <token>, User-Agent: TsuyaNoUchi, Content-Type: application/json; timeout via AbortSignal.timeout (e.g. 15s). Never include response text, address or email in errors, thrown messages or logs (use lib/safe-server-log.ts if logging at all).
